料號來自公開資料，下單前請以機台 Parts list 與銘牌確認: Part numbers come from public sources; verify against the robot's parts list and nameplates before ordering
公制六角扳手組（含長柄）: Metric hex key set (including long-arm keys)
套筒扳手組（含延長桿、萬向接頭）: Socket set (with extensions and universal joints)
範圍依手冊螺栓扭力表: Range per the bolt torque table in the manual
導桿（與固定螺栓同規格的長螺桿，對位用）: Guide studs (long studs of the same thread as the mounting bolts, for alignment)
刮刀、油石（清除舊密封膠與毛邊）: Scraper and oilstone (to remove old sealant and burrs)
額定荷重 ≥ 被吊物重量 2 倍（重量依手冊）: Rated load ≥ 2× the weight lifted (weights per the manual)
手冊指定的 J3 臂支撐方式: J3 arm support method specified in the manual
額定荷重符合吊掛計畫: Rated load to suit the lifting plan
手冊要求用手動泵: The manual requires a manual pump
電子秤（量注入與排出量）: Electronic scale (to weigh grease injected and drained)
標記筆、線材標籤（拆線前標記）: Marker pen and cable tags (mark before disconnecting)
依廠內採用的校正方式: Per the mastering method used on site
清潔溶劑、無塵布、吸油棉: Cleaning solvent, lint-free wipes, oil absorbent pads
參考估算，非原廠標準工時；第一次作業建議排兩個班次。密封膠若需固化時間另計。: Estimate only, not FANUC standard hours; plan two shifts for the first job. Add sealant curing time if required.
機器人維修技師：上鎖掛牌、拆裝馬達、零點校正、試運轉: Robot service technician: lockout/tagout, motor removal and installation, mastering, test run
拆裝減速機、清潔接合面、螺栓扭力、給脂: Reducer removal and installation, mating surface cleaning, bolt torque, greasing
持吊掛相關證照：吊車操作與指揮、J3 臂支撐: Certified for rigging: crane operation and signaling, J3 arm support
作業前召開工具箱會議：確認分工、吊掛計畫、緊急停止位置: Hold a toolbox meeting before starting: confirm roles, the lifting plan and emergency stop locations
控制器斷電並上鎖掛牌；每位進入圍籬的人員掛上自己的鎖: Power off the controller and apply lockout/tagout; everyone entering the fence applies their own lock
拆 J3 馬達或解除 J3 制動器前，先用 M10 環首螺栓 ×2 與吊帶把 J: Before removing the J3 motor or releasing the J3 brake, support the J3 arm with 2× M10 eyebolts and slings under load; an unsupported arm will fall
吊掛由持證人員指揮；吊物下方與移動路徑禁止站人；確認吊具額定荷重: Lifting is directed by a certified person; nobody under the load or in its path; check the rated load of the lifting gear
剛停機的馬達與減速機可能高溫：戴耐熱手套或等待冷卻: Motors and reducers may be hot right after stopping: wear heat-resistant gloves or let them cool
打開排脂口時油脂可能突然噴出：先套收集袋；給脂只用手動泵與指定油脂: Grease may spurt out when the outlet is opened: fit a collection bag first; grease only with a manual pump and the specified grease
需要送電點動（釋放殘壓、零點校正）時：人員退出圍籬或握持示教器使能開關，倍率 1: When power is needed for jogging (pressure release, mastering): everyone leaves the fence or holds the teach pendant enabling switch, override 10% or less
溶劑與密封膠在通風處使用並戴手套；廢脂與沾油廢棄物依廠內規定處理: Use solvents and sealants in a ventilated area with gloves; dispose of waste grease and oily waste per site rules
高處作業使用合格工作平台，依規定繫安全帶: For work at height use an approved platform and wear a harness as required
完工前清點工具，確認沒有遺留在機構內；解除掛牌由掛鎖人本人執行: Count tools before finishing and make sure none are left in the mechanism; each lock and tag is removed by the person who applied it
移到手冊指定的拆卸姿態、斷電上鎖、工具箱會議（核對備品與備份控制器在停機前完成）: Move to the removal posture specified in the manual, power off and lock out, toolbox meeting (check spare parts and back up the controller before the stop)
標記並拆下 J3 馬達線材，拆下 J3 馬達: Mark and disconnect the J3 motor cables, remove the J3 motor
拆固定螺栓、吊離 J3 臂組放上支撐架，頂出舊減速機: Remove the mounting bolts, lift the J3 arm assembly onto the support stand, jack out the old reducer
清潔接合面；檢查定位銷、螺孔、馬達側齒輪齒面: Clean the mating surfaces; inspect dowel pins, tapped holes and the motor-side gear teeth
安裝新減速機：O 形環、密封膠、對角分段鎖到規定扭力: Install the new reducer: O-rings, sealant, tighten in a cross pattern in stages to the specified torque
吊回 J3 臂並對位鎖固；裝回 J3 馬達並接線；確認制動器撐住後拆除吊具（送電: Lift the J3 arm back, align and bolt; refit and reconnect the J3 motor; remove the rigging once the brake holds (must be removed before power-on)
給脂（排脂口打開，注入到新脂流出）並釋放殘壓: Grease (outlet open, inject until new grease comes out) and release residual pressure
脈衝重置與 J3 零點校正；以既有程式點位確認: Pulse coder reset and J3 mastering; confirm with existing program points
試運轉、漏油與異音檢查；執行 DTM_DIAG 並登錄事件: Test run, check for leaks and abnormal noise; run DTM_DIAG and record the event
零件商標示為 R-2000iC/165F J3；其他負載型號後綴可能不同: Listed by a parts dealer as R-2000iC/165F J3; the suffix may differ for other payload variants
FANUC 給脂資料：R-2000iC 機構部用 A98L-0040-0174: FANUC greasing data: A98L-0040-0174 for the R-2000iC mechanical unit
密封墊損傷或塗膠失效就換新: Replace if the seal washer is damaged or the sealant has failed
減速機與 J3 臂固定螺栓: Reducer and J3 arm mounting bolts
拆下的螺栓若變形或螺紋損傷就換新: Replace removed bolts that are deformed or have damaged threads
J2 更換涉及平衡器與上臂支撐，工時與步驟請依手冊補上: J2 replacement involves the balancer and upper arm support; add hours and steps from the manual
機器人維修技師：上鎖掛牌、平衡器處置、零點校正: Robot service technician: lockout/tagout, balancer handling, mastering
拆裝減速機與平衡器、螺栓扭力、給脂: Reducer and balancer removal and installation, bolt torque, greasing
持吊掛相關證照：吊車操作與指揮: Certified for rigging: crane operation and signaling
J2 更換涉及平衡器：依手冊固定平衡器後才能拆解，平衡器內有彈簧預壓: J2 replacement involves the balancer: secure it per the manual before disassembly; the balancer contains a preloaded spring
拆 J2 馬達或解除制動器前，先支撐 J2 臂與上方機構；未支撐時手臂會落下: Before removing the J2 motor or releasing the brake, support the J2 arm and the mechanism above it; an unsupported arm will fall
控制器斷電並上鎖掛牌；吊掛由持證人員指揮: Power off the controller and apply lockout/tagout; lifting is directed by a certified person
零件商標示為 R-2000iC/165F J2: Listed by a parts dealer as R-2000iC/165F J2
減速機 O 形環、密封件、封止螺栓: Reducer O-rings, seals and seal bolts
參考估算；馬達拆下後需要脈衝重置與零點校正: Estimate only; a pulse coder reset and mastering are needed after the motor is removed
機器人維修技師：上鎖掛牌、拆裝馬達、脈衝重置、零點校正: Robot service technician: lockout/tagout, motor removal and installation, pulse coder reset, mastering
持吊掛相關證照：拆馬達前支撐手臂: Certified for rigging: support the arm before the motor is removed
控制器斷電並上鎖掛牌；拆線前標記: Power off the controller and apply lockout/tagout; mark cables before disconnecting
拆馬達前先支撐該軸手臂並受力；伺服馬達或制動器拆下後，未支撐的手臂會落下: Support the arm of that axis under load before removing the motor; once the servo motor or brake is removed, an unsupported arm will fall
剛停機的馬達可能高溫：戴耐熱手套或等待冷卻: The motor may be hot right after stopping: wear heat-resistant gloves or let it cool
送電點動時人員退出圍籬或握持示教器使能開關，倍率 10% 以下: When jogging with power on, everyone leaves the fence or holds the teach pendant enabling switch, override 10% or less
準備：核對馬達型號與銘牌、備份控制器、斷電上鎖: Preparation: check the motor model against the nameplate, back up the controller, power off and lock out
支撐手臂（環首螺栓＋吊帶受力）: Support the arm (eyebolts + slings under load)
標記並拆下線材，拆下馬達: Mark and disconnect the cables, remove the motor
檢查齒輪與減速機輸入端；裝新馬達（新 O 形環）並接線；確認制動器撐住後拆除吊具: Inspect the gear and reducer input; fit the new motor (new O-ring) and connect; remove the rigging once the brake holds
脈衝重置與零點校正；以既有程式點位確認: Pulse coder reset and mastering; confirm with existing program points
試運轉、溫度與異音檢查；執行 DTM_DIAG 並登錄事件: Test run, check temperature and abnormal noise; run DTM_DIAG and record the event
FANUC R-2000iC 型錄（A-97606-0293E）列為 J2、J3: Listed as the J2 and J3 motor in the FANUC R-2000iC catalog (A-97606-0293E)
以機台馬達銘牌為準: The motor nameplate on the robot takes precedence
參考估算，單軸；給脂量與殘壓釋放時間依手冊: Estimate only, per axis; grease volume and pressure release time per the manual
機器人維修技師：上鎖掛牌、點動到給脂姿態、釋放殘壓: Robot service technician: lockout/tagout, jog to the greasing posture, release residual pressure
開關封止螺栓、給脂、秤重、取樣: Open and close seal bolts, grease, weigh, take samples
開關封止螺栓時斷電上鎖；需要點動時人員退出圍籬: Power off and lock out while opening or closing seal bolts; leave the fence when jogging is needed
打開排脂口時油脂可能突然噴出：先套收集袋: Grease may spurt out when the outlet is opened: fit a collection bag first
只用手動泵與指定油脂；給脂時排脂口必須打開，避免內壓損傷油封: Use only a manual pump and the specified grease; keep the outlet open while greasing so internal pressure does not damage the oil seals
點動到給脂姿態，斷電上鎖: Jog to the greasing posture, power off and lock out
以手動泵從給脂口注入，直到排脂口流出新脂；記錄注入與排出重量: Inject through the inlet with a manual pump until new grease comes out of the outlet; record the weights injected and drained
排脂口打開，依手冊運轉釋放殘壓: With the outlet open, run the robot per the manual to release residual pressure
裝回封止螺栓、清潔；在 DTM 登錄換脂與鐵粉: Refit the seal bolts and clean up; record the grease change and iron debris in DTM
密封墊損傷就換新: Replace if the seal washer is damaged
鐵粉取樣瓶（舊脂中段、24 小時後殘留）: Iron debris sample bottles (middle portion of old grease, residual after 24 h)
支撐 J3 臂（環首螺栓＋吊帶受力）；排出舊脂，先丟棄前段、取中段作鐵粉樣本: Support the J3 arm (eyebolts + slings under load); drain the old grease, discard the first portion and take the middle portion as the iron debris sample
打開排脂口並套袋；排出的舊脂先丟棄前段（排出口附近停滯的油脂），取中段約 5 g: Open the outlet and fit a bag; discard the first portion of the drained grease (stagnant grease near the outlet) and bottle about 5 g of the middle portion as the iron debris sample (DTM sample type: purged grease (middle portion))
參考估算；依行走軸廠商手冊。更換後需檢查小齒輪與齒條嚙合間隙、零點校正: Estimate only; follow the travel axis manufacturer's manual. After replacement, check the pinion-to-rack backlash and do mastering
機器人維修技師：上鎖掛牌、行走軸固定、零點校正: Robot service technician: lockout/tagout, securing the travel axis, mastering
拆裝馬達與減速機、調整齒條嚙合、螺栓扭力: Motor and reducer removal and installation, rack mesh adjustment, bolt torque
持吊掛相關證照：減速機吊掛: Certified for rigging: lifting the reducer
控制器斷電並上鎖掛牌；行走軸滑座以止動塊或楔塊固定，防止滑移: Power off the controller and apply lockout/tagout; secure the travel axis carriage with stops or wedges so it cannot slide
軌道兩端與滑座周邊設警戒區，禁止人員進入行走範圍: Set up barriers at both ends of the track and around the carriage; nobody may enter the travel range
吊掛由持證人員指揮；減速機重量依手冊確認吊具荷重: Lifting is directed by a certified person; check the lifting gear rating against the reducer weight in the manual
準備：核對減速機型號、備份控制器、斷電上鎖、固定滑座: Preparation: check the reducer model, back up the controller, power off and lock out, secure the carriage
拆下馬達（標記線材），拆下減速機與小齒輪: Remove the motor (mark the cables), remove the reducer and pinion
檢查齒條磨耗與異物；裝新減速機與小齒輪，調整嚙合間隙: Check the rack for wear and foreign matter; fit the new reducer and pinion and adjust the backlash
裝回馬達、接線、給脂；零點校正並以既有程式點位確認: Refit the motor, reconnect, grease; do mastering and confirm with existing program points
低速往返試運轉、異音與溫度檢查；執行 DTM_DIAG（E1 段）並登錄事件: Test run back and forth at low speed, check noise and temperature; run DTM_DIAG (E1 segment) and record the event
依行走軸 Parts list: Per the travel axis parts list
以行走軸銘牌與廠商手冊為準: Per the travel axis nameplate and the manufacturer's manual
小齒輪磨耗時一併更換: Replace together if the pinion is worn
齒輪箱與齒條用潤滑脂: Grease for the gearbox and rack
依行走軸手冊指定: As specified in the travel axis manual
E1 行走軸給脂（齒輪箱、齒條與小齒輪）: E1 travel axis greasing (gearbox, rack and pinion)
參考估算；給脂週期與給脂量依行走軸廠商手冊（自動給脂器的話檢查殘量與出脂）: Estimate only; greasing interval and amount per the travel axis manufacturer's manual (with an automatic lubricator, check the remaining amount and output)
機器人維修技師：上鎖掛牌、行走軸低速往返: Robot service technician: lockout/tagout, low-speed back-and-forth travel
齒輪箱給脂、齒條清潔與塗脂、自動給脂器檢查: Gearbox greasing, rack cleaning and greasing, automatic lubricator check
給脂、清潔齒條時斷電上鎖並固定滑座: Power off, lock out and secure the carriage while greasing and cleaning the rack
需要往返運轉讓油脂分布時，人員退出行走範圍、倍率 10% 以下: When back-and-forth travel is needed to spread the grease, everyone leaves the travel range and the override is 10% or less
斷電上鎖、固定滑座，清除齒條舊脂與粉塵，目視檢查齒面: Power off and lock out, secure the carriage, remove old grease and dust from the rack, visually check the tooth flanks
齒輪箱依手冊給脂（排脂口打開）；齒條與小齒輪塗脂或補充自動給脂器: Grease the gearbox per the manual (outlet open); grease the rack and pinion or refill the automatic lubricator
低速全行程往返數次讓油脂分布；在 DTM 登錄換脂: Travel the full stroke back and forth several times at low speed to spread the grease; record the grease change in DTM
